description: Read the site a building stands on, in its level coordinates: the lot and its area, with the footprint a house usually covers on it (30 to 45%); the buildable area inside the setbacks with its centre, its area, each edge's frontage and depth, and its front edge (behind the street; while no street is recorded, behind the edge facing north, which the setbacks take as the front); the street side with the lot's frontage and depth on it; north; the ground (sloped with its fall, read flat, or not read); the address, parcel and zoning when known; whether the lot is only the new-project placeholder; and where the footprint sits now with its yards.

building.description: The building, by its id (list_levels' parentId). Default: the building of the floor the person is viewing, else the scene's only building.

site.description: The site, by its id (get_site's siteId), when the scene has several: a lot no building stands on yet reads in site coordinates. Default: the building's site.

name: get_site
title: Get site
